big_messages.message: FY26: revenue Rs 531 Cr (2.4x), PAT Rs 123 Cr (+146%), Q4 EBITDA margin 32.2%. Q1 FY27 accelerates: Rs 175 Cr, PAT Rs 42 Cr.
Dream City Builders (WOS) to execute full EPC — construction, finishing, handover — of 93-storey Jeddah tower; Rs 1,800 Cr over ~5 years, subject to approvals.
AGM seeks Rs 530 Cr related-party approvals FY27-28; almost debt-free; promoter 67.56% stable; FII/DII trimmed since listing.

bottom_line.breaks: Jeddah approvals stall + debtors re-stretch — growth story pauses, 12x still derates on governance discount.
bottom_line.core: Not a tender grinder — asset-light building EPC, 32% OPM, 41.8% ROCE, debt-free, doubling yearly.
bottom_line.changed: IPO-base to doubling machine: Rs 225 Cr -> Rs 531 Cr in one year; Q1 FY27 run-rate ~Rs 700 Cr.
bottom_line.hidden: Watch cash, not PAT — CFO was Rs -111 Cr in FY25; Rs +41 Cr FY26 must repeat as Jeddah mobilises.
bottom_line.question: Does Jeddah move from MoU to mobilisation — and does 32% OPM survive Saudi execution?
bottom_line.takeaway: Own the speed, verify the cash — Rs 150 buy zone vs Rs 177.
